name: How long does garage trim installation take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does garage trim installation take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard exterior and interior garage trim installations take between half a day and two days to complete. A straightforward replacement of exterior garage door brick molding or perimeter casing is typically finished within a single day. The timeline extends if the contractor discovers water damage in the framing, requires structural jamb rebuilding, or handles full interior baseboard and drywall finishing as part of a larger garage remodel. Factoring in primer drying time, caulk curing, and finish painting also affects total completion time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most garage trim projects take between half a day and two full days, depending on the number of openings, weather conditions, and whether underlying framing needs repair.
